sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P1 靠墙倒立移重）

purpose.zh: 练倒立时把重心移到单手、支撑臂锁直，为托马斯单手支撑打底
purpose.en: Trains shifting your handstand weight onto one locked arm, a base for one-arm support in flairs.

text.zh: 支撑手臂锁直，重心慢慢移到这只手上
text.en: Support arm locked, slowly bring your weight over that hand

text.zh: 胸腹朝墙倒立，手离墙约一掌长、手指背离墙，肩往上顶。
text.en: Chest-to-wall handstand, hands about a hand length from the wall, fingers pointing away from it, push tall.

text.zh: 另一只手掌根抬起，只留指尖点地；停一下再回中间换边。
text.en: Let the other palm lift so only the fingertips touch; pause, back to the middle, then switch.
When your shoulders tire, come down and rest.

commonErrors.zh: 只是歪头歪身子，重心没移过去
commonErrors.en: Leaning your head or hips without actually moving your weight.

cautions.zh: 先能稳定保持面墙倒立 30 秒再练；手腕或肩疼就停
cautions.en: Hold a 30 s chest-to-wall handstand first; stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt.

training.source: flare2 r1 animation tempo (4 s per side: 0.5 s centre, 1.5 s shift, 1 s pause, 1 s back); 表：左右各一次计 1 次，剂量标「每侧」

flare2.plans: 2 个计划（三角肌高级；阶段 11/15 高级）
flare2.camera: 背后（房间一侧）偏右 14°，看左右移重和放松手
flare2.doseBrief: 表：左右各一次计 1 次，剂量标「每侧」；草稿 3 组 × 4 次（每侧）、休 60 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): left first. Shoulders 15 cm toward the support hand, body rolls so the feet slide ~24 cm along the wall, COM over the support palm (0.92); free hand heel up ~16 mm, fingertips on the mat, free elbow ~149 deg.

reminders.zh: 支撑手臂锁直，另一只手只留指尖点地
reminders.en: Support arm locked, other hand on fingertips only
